diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly defaulted to the shared draft values, which are the exact opposites of the hidden information. Specifically, the model consistently chose 'immediate broad launch' (contradicting PF4), 2-decimal half-up billing (contradicting PF1), no invoice previews (contradicting PF2), and 90-day retention without pseudonymization (contradicting PF3).

fix_instructions: To make the scenario require multi-agent coordination, the shared draft must be ambiguous or neutral regarding these parameters so that the lone decision-maker cannot determine the correct values without the private facts. For example, change the shared draft for C2/C3 to say 'billing precision and rounding should follow standard industry practices' instead of specifying 'two-decimal half-up', and change the shared draft for C6/C7 to say 'data retention should comply with privacy regulations' instead of specifying '90 days without transformation'.
